note: The dispatchable graph. tools/dispatch_plan.py reads this and emits the largest conflict-free set of ready tasks. Status values: blocked, ready, in_flight, review, done. A task is dispatchable only when every dependency is done, its gate is cleared, and no file it owns is owned by a task already in flight.

gates.none: No human decision required. Fully automatic.
gates.brendan_art: Spends paid credits or requires visual acceptance. Requires an approved entry in docs/planning/art_approvals.json. NEVER auto-cleared.
gates.astra_ruling: Requires a planning decision this executor may not invent. Requires the named request in docs/rulings/requests/ to be answered.
